title: ihris-ig-build-patches/v1
description: Fixes applied to a WORKSPACE copy of a sub-instance's declared IG source before fhir-harness builds it (src/tools/apply_ig_patches.py). Each replaces one exact text, exactly once; the mounted source and the upstream are never edited. Each entry is an upstream defect to report, removed when the pinned source fixes it.

source.description: owner/repo@commit the patches were written against: must equal the sub-instance's declared source.
